case 04: label billing questions with the predicate field
block:
{"summary": "Label billing questions so the billing team sees them.",
"rules": [{"predicate": {"op": "body_has", "terms": ["invoice", "refund", "charged twice"]}, "action": "label", "label": "billing", "weight": 4}]}

name: case 05: routing sent as an object keyed by type
block:
{"summary": "Route Spanish tickets to the regional team.",
"routing": {"team_adjust": {"add": ["support-es"], "note": "Spanish speakers"}}}

name: case 06: routing sent as an object instead of a list
block:
{"summary": "Add the billing team to routing.",
"routing": {"type": "team_adjust", "add": ["billing"], "note": "Billing now takes payment tickets"}}

name: case 07: routing as a list with add and remove
block:
{"summary": "Billing takes payment tickets, the general queue stops getting them.",
"remove_routing": [],
"routing": [
{"type": "team_adjust", "add": ["billing"], "remove": ["general"]}]
}

name: case 08: routing with an empty remove and nothing to add
block:
{"summary": "Stop routing to the general queue.",
"routing": [{"type": "team_adjust", "remove": [], "note": "nothing listed"}]}
